'''Koo Millham''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served in the [[Ground Logistics Division]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> of the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. 

==Biography==
[[File:WatchingDadGoToWork-TLJ.png|thumb|250px|left|Millham, Minnau and Kuchimba staring in confusion as Skywalker walks out of the base.]]
Koo Millham was amongst the members of the Resistance who survived the First Order's assault at the [[Battle of Oetchi]] following the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]. Millham reached the surface of [[Crait]] in a [[U-55 orbital loadlifter]]. There the remaining Resistance members held out against the First Order in an abandoned [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Crait outpost|outpost]] and bore witness to the appearance of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]], with Millham watching with [[Saile Minnau]] and [[Salaka Kuchimba]] as he strode out to confront the First Order. While the [[Jedi]] distracted their foes, those that survived the onslaught eventually escaped<ref name="TLJ" /> on the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. She wore a light [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|duty uniform]] with a dark brown [[scarf]] and [[belt]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> Millham had fair skin and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koo Millham was portrayed by [[Chelsea Hamill]], daughter of [[Mark Hamill]], in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
